game_title: Countdown Launch – Ore Vein Depths Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Shadow Cave – Ore Vein Depths, a rich ore vein: the cave miner must handle shadow wraiths while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Countdown Launch: Tick a countdown down each loop until it hits zero and the launch fires.
theme: Shadow Cave – Ore Vein Depths: a rich ore vein
core_gameplay_loop: In Ore Vein Depths, repeat each round: Tick a countdown down each loop until it hits zero and the launch fires. Each round, shadow wraiths strike the cave gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the count value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the cave gate from shadow wraiths in Ore Vein Depths: keep the count meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 39-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: count drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 39-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 4 (applied tier): Countdown Launch
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how count changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow wraiths in Ore Vein Depths.
